column1: # ldx_census.tsv — per-class divergence census of the shipped T1 encoder vs the
# exact libdeflate port (src/compress/ldx/), via the oracle in
# Grid: src/fixtures.rs synthetic fixtures x levels {1, 2, 6, 9} at T1.
# Levels 2/6/9 are byte-tie levels: their rows pin divergence == 0.
# ours_bytes / ldx_bytes are raw DEFLATE stream sizes (no gzip framing).
# first_pos is the uncompressed position of the first divergent decision
# ('-' when the token streams are decision-identical).
# These are SNAPSHOT pins, not aspirations. We need NOT converge to
# libdeflate's parse — the goal is size <= theirs, not identity — and a
# changed census is not automatically bad. The pin exists so that
# parse-structure movement is DELIBERATE and visible in the diff of this
# file, reviewed next to the size delta it bought.
